cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Per NDTV Profit, BITS Pilani will offer full scholarships to the top 1,000 BITSAT rankers from 2027. Group Vice Chancellor V Ramgopal Rao said it is for eligible students whose annual family income does not exceed ₹20 lakh. For 2026, BITS had offered tuition-blind admission to the top 500 rankers (Careers360). Whether it covers hostel and mess, and campus-wise split, were not in the summary we read.
